name: The Summoning

angles.text: As a warrior, facing Cyclonian and claiming the Whirlwind Heart is a proving ground. It yields a weapon infused with the raw power of the tempest.
As a troll, you know Bath'rah Windwatcher's primal arts reach far beyond civilization. His command of wind elementals reflects the deep mystical traditions of troll shamans and witch doctors.

faq.answer: Cyclonian is a powerful elemental known as the wind lord. Bath'rah Windwatcher's ritual calls him forth as a fierce tempest, and he must be defeated to claim the essence sealed in his core.
The Whirlwind Heart is Cyclonian's elemental core. Bath'rah Windwatcher needs it to bind the wind lord's swirling, destructive power into a weapon.

Bath'rah Windwatcher is a troll mystic who lives in the wilderness and knows how to summon Cyclonian. He guides warriors through the ritual, then uses the fallen elemental's heart to forge mighty weapons.
Cyclonian is summoned so a warrior can face and slay the wind lord, then claim his elemental heart. Its power can be bound into a weapon.
After Cyclonian falls, Bath'rah can harness the elemental power in his Whirlwind Heart to empower a weapon with Cyclonian's stormcraft.
faq.q: What happens after Cyclonian is defeated?

faq.answer: The ritual takes place at Bath'rah Windwatcher's camp. There, the mystic gathers the primal focus needed to draw Cyclonian from the elemental realm into the physical world.
faq.q: Where does the summoning take place?

sections.body: Bath'rah Windwatcher has prepared an ancient ritual to summon Cyclonian into the mortal realm. The fearsome elemental is known as the wind lord. There will be no bargain with the tempest. An able champion must strike it down as soon as it takes form.
sections.title: Calling the Tempest

sections.body: Cyclonian's Whirlwind Heart sustains his physical form. When the wind lord falls, Bath'rah wrenches the heart free and harnesses the gale within. Its volatile power can imbue a weapon with the force of the storm.
sections.title: The Heart of the Storm

summary: At Bath'rah Windwatcher's camp, a warrior faces a trial against Cyclonian, the wind lord. Slay the elemental and claim the Whirlwind Heart, whose storm force can be bound into a weapon.
